summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting final results from its Lowhee Zone infill drill program at the Cariboo Gold Project. The release details a 17,072-metre infill program (185 holes) that validated existing geological assumptions; a reconciliation analysis showed modest local grade/tonnage variability. The company also noted it expects to satisfy technical conditions for the remaining US$350M undrawn project loan facility in Q3 2026, pending Appian Capital Advisory's review. This is a routine operational and project-financing update. No change of control, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is a foreign private issuer's operational progress report.
